mapper.sql: settings.setting_id as "settingId", settings.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", versions.version_code as "versionCode", versions.version_status as "versionStatus", settings.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", settings.area_code as "achievementAreaCode", items.item_code as "achievementCategoryCode", settings.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", settings.college_code as "collegeCode", settings.evaluation_score as "evaluationScore", settings.sort_order as "sortOrder", settings.active_yn as "activeYn", settings.change_reason as "changeReason", settings.updated_by as "updatedBy", settings.updated_at as "updatedAt"

from management_item_score_settings settings inner join evaluation_rule_versions versions on versions.rule_version_id = settings.rule_version_id left join evaluation_areas areas on areas.rule_version_id = settings.rule_version_id and areas.area_code = settings.area_code left join evaluation_items items on items.area_id = areas.area_id left join evaluation_elements elements on elements.item_id = items.item_id and elements.evaluation_year = settings.evaluation_year left join evaluation_management_items management_items on management_items.element_id = elements.element_id and management_items.management_item_code = settings.management_item_code
mapper.select:
select distinct
order by settings.evaluation_year desc, settings.area_code, items.item_code, settings.management_item_code, settings.college_code, settings.sort_order limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select version_status from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = #{ruleVersionId}
select to_char(effective_start_date, 'YYYY') from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = #{ruleVersionId}

insert into management_item_score_settings ( rule_version_id, evaluation_year, area_code, management_item_code, college_code, evaluation_score, sort_order, active_yn, change_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by ) values ( #{request.ruleVersionId}, (select to_char(effective_start_date, 'YYYY') from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = #{request.ruleVersionId}), #{request.achievementAreaCode}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.collegeCode}, #{request.evaluationScore}, #{request.sortOrder}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{requestId}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy} ) on conflict (rule_version_id, evaluation_year, area_code, management_item_code, college_code) do update set evaluation_score = EXCLUDED.evaluation_score, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by returning setting_id as "settingId", rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", (select version_code from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = management_item_score_settings.rule_version_id) as "versionCode", (select version_status from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = management_item_score_settings.rule_version_id) as "versionStatus", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", area_code as "achievementAreaCode", #{request.achievementCategoryCode} as "achievementCategoryCode", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", college_code as "collegeCode", evaluation_score as "evaluationScore", sort_order as "sortOrder", active_yn as "activeYn", change_reason as "changeReason", updated_by as "updatedBy", updated_at as "updatedAt"
